bullets: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1: exclude bin/obj/.vs/.uwp-source/.git from the source-file copy so stale UWP build artifacts (e.g. nested obj *.AssemblyInfo.cs / .NETCore AssemblyAttributes.cs) are never dragged in and globbed, eliminating CS0579 duplicate-attribute build failures.

MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md: document the CS0579 'Duplicate ...Attribute' build error (nested-obj globbing root cause, delete stray obj/bin, DefaultItemExcludes=**/obj/**;**/bin/**, remove carried-over Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs) so the agent diagnoses it in one step.
